title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: planned people resolution for custom connectors
summary: The briefing passes: its documented controls and licensing are supported, and it distinguishes the overdue roadmap target from the published Graph property types. Two descriptive statements need narrowing: the roadmap promises to avoid complex Graph lookups, not every lookup, and the documentation does not establish that the planned matching already operates in Copilot answers.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to resolve external emails or user IDs from third-party sources to corresponding Microsoft Entra identities.
claims.quote: This feature enables connectors to resolve external identities—such as email addresses or user IDs from third-party data sources—to their corresponding Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identities.

claims.fix: Replace 'developers will no longer need their own Microsoft Graph lookups' with 'developers can simplify integration workflows without needing complex Graph API lookups', as the roadmap states.
